infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Tinkrum transcribes recordings on this device when you run speech to text. Recordings stay on this device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tinkrum accesses your photo library when you choose photos or videos to process. Your files stay on this device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Tinkrum saves photos and videos to your library only when you ask it to.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tinkrum uses the camera when you take a photo or scan a document. Photos stay on this device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Tinkrum uses the microphone when you record audio. Recordings stay on this device.
